name: Sasono Payments for WooCommerce
author: Sasono

sections.description:
Sasono Payments for WooCommerce allows customers to pay using Sasono prepaid codes directly at checkout. No bank account or credit history required — just enter a prepaid code and email to complete the order.

Why use Sasono Payments?

  • Simple: Customers just enter their prepaid code and email.
  • Secure: Codes are unique and encrypted for safe transactions.
  • Accessible: No credit card or bank account required.
  • Flexible: Works with WooCommerce Classic Checkout and WooCommerce Blocks.
  • Compliant: Fully compatible with High Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Use Cases

Sasono prepaid codes can be used for:

  • E-commerce (tech, apparel, lifestyle products)
  • Social media & premium services
  • Digital downloads (ebooks, software, games)
  • Travel & ticketing
  • Shopping with a growing network of online retailers

Features

  • Accept Sasono prepaid code payments in WooCommerce.
  • Simple checkout fields for voucher code and email.
  • Supports Classic Checkout and WooCommerce Blocks Checkout.
  • HPOS (High Performance Order Storage) compatible.
  • Validates user input with WordPress sanitization and escaping standards.
  • Easy setup — no technical skills required.

Get Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  3. Enable Sasono Payments and configure it.
  4. Customers will now see a “Pay with Sasono” option at checkout.
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or newer
  • WooCommerce 9.6 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • A valid Sasono account to process payments

Installation Instructions

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Upload the sasono-payments-for-woocommerce.zip file.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  6. Enable Sasono Payments and adjust settings as needed.
sections.faq:
What is Sasono?

Sasono is a prepaid code payment solution. Customers buy codes from authorized resellers and use them to pay securely online.

Do I need a Sasono account to use this plugin?

Yes. Merchants must have a verified Sasono account to accept payments.

Does this plugin store sensitive data?

No. The plugin only transmits the prepaid code and email securely to Sasono for validation. No payment details are stored on your site.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce Blocks Checkout?

Yes, this plugin works with both Classic Checkout and the new WooCommerce Blocks Checkout.

Can customers partially use a Sasono code?

Yes. If a prepaid code is only partially spent, Sasono issues a new code for the remaining balance.

What happens if a customer loses their prepaid code?

Sasono prepaid codes should be treated like cash. Lost or stolen codes cannot be replaced.

Is Sasono available internationally?

Yes. Sasono prepaid codes can be redeemed with any participating merchant worldwide.

What WooCommerce versions are supported?

The plugin requires WooCommerce 9.6+ and WordPress 6.5+. It has been tested up to WooCommerce 10.1.
